selections.description: Keep the Python target parser aligned with selected behavior from the separate Rust reference.
acceptance: Shared fixtures produce equivalent parsed values and error classifications.
Relevant upstream regression cases have corresponding Python target tests for Unicode, offsets, and boundary behavior.
The configured Python tests pass unchanged apart from additive regression cases.

instructions.goal: Port the selected Rust parser behavior into the registered target's existing Python parser while preserving the target's module API and observable error categories.
adaptation: Use the target's existing Python types, exceptions, and module layout; translate behavior rather than copying Rust syntax.
Use shared fixtures and add focused target regression tests for relevant upstream behavior changes.
Preserve documented offset semantics and report blocked if byte offsets cannot be represented without an unapproved API change.
nonGoals: Do not add Rust bindings, a parser generator, or new dependencies.
Do not change the target-only normalization helper, package exports, or unrelated parser features.
Do not edit tests/parser/fixtures/**; those fixtures are protected input to the target verification suite.

preserve: Keep the target-only normalization helper and public Python exports unchanged.
Do not change trusted regression fixtures or weaken parser assertions.
